name: Dreams made of obsession
source:
The monster that haunts your nightmares wants to date you.

You are a student who abandons the lecture halls to earn money. Haunted in your dreams by an unknown beast, it seems to want to possess you but not in the way you thought. Will you let a possessive monster control your life because its silhouette is kind of hot? (mystery...)
